heavy_strike.name: Heavy Strike
heavy_strike.description: A full-power blow, heavy as a mountain.
heavy_strike.detail: Chance on attack to boost the damage multiplier of that strike.

execution.name: Execute
execution.detail: Chance to greatly boost damage when the target is below the HP threshold.

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.detail: Converts a portion of damage dealt into HP.

venom.name: Venom Blade
venom.detail: Chance on attack to poison the foe, dealing damage on each of their actions.

stun_blow.name: Stunning Hammer
stun_blow.detail: Chance on attack to stun the foe, skipping their next action.

combo.name: Combo
combo.detail: Chance on attack to land an additional weaker strike.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.description: Those who harm me shall be harmed.
thorns.detail: Reflects part of the damage taken back at the attacker.

wind_step.name: Wind Step
wind_step.description: A body like the wind, untouchable.

spring_heal.name: Renewal
spring_heal.description: A gentle warmth wells up inside.
spring_heal.detail: Chance to recover HP at the start of an action.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.detail: Once HP falls below the threshold, ATK is increased for the rest of the fight.
